operations.description: Branch on enable flag at this+0x32BC: non-zero stores parameters into struct fields, zero applies them directly.

Store a4 into wheel force parameter 3 at this+0x3854.
Store a5 into wheel force parameter 4 at this+0x394C.
Apply force/torque parameters directly to the rigid body via ForceTorqueApplicationToRigidBodyWithInertiaTens(&dbl_7C7428, a2, a3, a4, a5) when the enable flag is zero.
